captions.text: Same B6 contingency. Left: no response. Right: linear-programming optimiser.
Before the outage: demand is served in both runs. The left run already has line overloads.
Half-hour snapshots advance together. Arrowheads show the direction of electricity flow.
The B6 boundary carries electricity from Scotland towards northern England.
Inspecting SSCO-NORT: flow and capacity come from the API.
B6 trips. The same boundary is unavailable in both runs.
No response: northern England and downstream zones develop unmet demand.
Scotland is islanded but still supplied. Red nodes indicate shortages elsewhere.
The optimiser keeps demand served, with no red overloaded lines throughout the episode.
0 MWh unserved at dashboard precision across the full episode.
Full episode: 53,418 vs 0 MWh unserved. Costs: £371M vs £72M.
Model penalties are separate from cost: about £5 for the optimiser.
RL agents were also trained; they did not beat the optimiser.
